entries.what: ASR Ltd (2010a) 'Kovalam coastal protection' technical report, and the CESS (Centre for Earth Science Studies) morphological assessment of the Kovalam reef
entries.where: 5 web searches 2026-10-10 (e.g. 'Kovalam artificial reef ASR report pdf geocontainer', 'CESS Kovalam reef morphological assessment'); asrltd.com
entries.by: agent: Kovalam network pass (fresh agent, cloud)
entries.detail: No open copy of either report. asrltd.com was unreachable from the sandbox. Only text pages turned up (Patagonia 2010 repost, textiles.org / Specialty Fabrics Review, Kerala Tourism 2005 newsletter), none with a plan or dimensions of the built reef. ICCE 2012 Rendle and Davidson (doi 10.9753/icce.v33.structures.21) only cites ASR 2010 (the web page). Lior's papers/ give only unlocated ranges (Blacka et al. 2013 Table 4.2: submergence 0.2-3.4 m, depth 1.3-3.7 m, no datum), so crest level, container size and design plan are still missing.
entries.might_work: Lior: P11 / W6 / E13 (ASR Ltd, Raglan NZ; CESS Thiruvananthapuram)

entries.what: Esri Wayback releases of Kovalam bay (197 releases) for a vertical view of the reef strips, 2010-2020
entries.by: agent: Kovalam network pass (fresh agent, cloud)
entries.detail: There are no releases dated 2010-2013 (the first, 2014-02-20 = release 10, carries the 2011-02-28 capture). z19 tiles x 374246-374249, y 249884-249886 for every release up to 2018 are the 196-byte blank no-data tile; real z19 exists only from 2022-08-10 and z18 from 2021-07-21. The finest earlier imagery is z17 (1.19 m/px): six distinct captures viewed (2011-02-28, 2014-12-03, 2017-02-27, 2018-09-06, 2019-10-09, 2020-11-18; registry img-20) show surf zone and swash but no strips, because the 1 m wide containers are below the pixel size. The capture-date metadata query timed out, so dates of later releases are release dates.
entries.might_work: Google Earth Pro historical imagery Feb 2010-2012 (Lior: G9); a post-2022 z19 frame has not been checked for remnants

entries.what: Esri World Imagery current layer (z16-z19, capture 2026-01-23) and Google Maps satellite around the lighthouse end of Kovalam
entries.where: https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/World_Imagery/MapServer ; Google Maps satellite near 8.400 N, 76.978 E
entries.by: agent: Kovalam shape agent (cloud); Google Maps pass by Kovalam verification 2026-09-25
entries.detail: Esri current frames (registry img-10 to img-14) locate the bay but the submerged reef is not visible. The 2026-09-25 verification also panned Google Maps satellite from Samudra Beach south through Kovalam / Hawa Beach to the lighthouse point and found no satellite-visible remnant. The reef later sank and deflated, so this is no evidence of absence in 2010.

entries.detail: No matching document under either title and year. A real 2015 paper by Ng, Thomas, Phillips et al. (Ocean & Coastal Management, 'Multifunctional artificial reefs for small islands') exists but is a different paper and its body was not accessible. Gemini lead not confirmed; the 1.6 m crest is not used. A Wikipedia 'Multi-purpose reef' check also found no Kovalam content.

entries.what: EMODnet Bathymetry DTM 2024 (viewer, REST, ERDDAP) for seabed depth at the reef
entries.where: https://emodnet.ec.europa.eu/geoviewer/ ; EMODnet Bathymetry REST depth_sample / ERDDAP bathymetry_dtm_2024 at 8.4004, 76.9787
entries.detail: EMODnet covers European seas only; the REST service returns HTTP 204 (empty) at this reef's coordinate (India), so the site is outside the grid. Only two of the 13 reefs are covered (Boscombe, Borth). Do not retry EMODnet for this reef.
